notes.title: NEW UPDATE includes GERMAN language translation
notes.content: NEW update now includes full GERMAN version of the game.

notes.title: UPDATES and FIXES 06 MARCH 2022
notes.content:
UPDATES

- Higher screen resolutions are now out of BETA and functional

- OPTIONS now include a Y-axis mouse invert

- Major improvement to most in-game sound FX, upgraded from mono to stereo

- Correction of missing environment floor on SPRING level

- Correction to railings on DROPDOWN level (to prevent cheating)

- Improvement to lighting on word puzzles and PASSWORD HALL

notes.title: Second Mouse Speed update plus UNTESTED new screen sizes
notes.content:
Much improved Mouse Sensitivity in both DEMO and FULL GAME  with much wider speed range.

New Screen Resolution Options added on Splash Screen only:
1920 x 1200 (UNTESTED)
2560 x 1440 (UNTESTED)
3840 x 2160 (UNTESTED) 4K

Removed unnecessary "Esc Pause" icon from in-game

notes.title: Update Notes for FEB 04 2022
notes.content:
